**docs:** a reusable local audit prompt under `docs/audit/language-alternatives.md` compares Rust, TypeScript/Bun, Zig, Go, C++, C# Native AOT and Ruby/Spinel across correctness gates, runtime gates, representative prototypes, measured agent iteration time and migration economics, with a baseline measurement procedure and a decision matrix. The audit itself and any migration are separate work; artifacts stay local under the `docs/audit/` exclusion.
